primitives.name: Claim Governance Bypass

primitives.assumptions: AI-generated scripts lack human oversight, leading to forbidden language inclusion.

primitives.name: Auto-Upload Violation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Auto-upload violates Sports OS policy**: No content may auto-publish to any external platform without operator review.
primitives.assumptions: Automated publishing bypasses operator control and introduces risk of policy non-compliance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Policy failure when content is published without explicit operator approval.

layer2.mapping: Auto-upload is a derived failure of procedural control; GSE models it as a transition from manual to automated state without operator consent.

primitives.name: AI Disclosure Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sports OS goes beyond YouTube's minimum requirement — ALL AI-generated content is disclosed, not just content that could be mistaken for real.
primitives.assumptions: Full transparency is required for all AI-generated media to maintain trust and avoid platform penalties.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Compliance failure if AI content is not fully disclosed.

layer2.mapping: The isomorphism between AI content creation and disclosure obligations mirrors GSI's probabilistic model of content authenticity and platform risk.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of AI-generated content with full disclosure tags.
